## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds or changes **one** entry in `community-addins.json`, and no other file.
- [ ] The `id` in my entry is the same as the `id` in my add-in's `manifest.json`.
- [ ] My repository has a published (not draft, not pre-release) GitHub release with `manifest.json` and `main.js` attached as files (and `styles.css` if I use one).
- [ ] The version in `manifest.json` matches the release tag (for example version `1.0.0`, tag `v1.0.0`).
- [ ] My repository has a `README.md` that explains what the add-in does and how to use it.
- [ ] My repository has a `LICENSE` file.
- [ ] `main.js` is readable source code: not minified, not obfuscated, and it does not download or run code from elsewhere.
- [ ] My add-in does not collect or send the user's text or data anywhere.
- [ ] I tried the add-in in Markooj, and it works.
- [ ] I have read [POLICIES.md](https://github.com/datakeen/markooj-addins/blob/main/POLICIES.md).
